tasks.label: publish-standalone
tasks.command: dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}/src/RomSieve.App/RomSieve.App.csproj' -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o '${workspaceFolder}/publish' && mv -f '${workspaceFolder}/publish/RomSieve.App.exe' '${workspaceFolder}/publish/RomSieve.exe'

windows.command: dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}/src/RomSieve.App/RomSieve.App.csproj' -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o '${workspaceFolder}/publish'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Move-Item -Force '${workspaceFolder}/publish/RomSieve.App.exe' '${workspaceFolder}/publish/RomSieve.exe' }

tasks.command: dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}/src/RomSieve.App/RomSieve.App.csproj' -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux' && mv -f '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux/RomSieve.App' '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux/RomSieve'

windows.command: dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}/src/RomSieve.App/RomSieve.App.csproj' -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Move-Item -Force '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux/RomSieve.App' '${workspaceFolder}/publish-linux/RomSieve' }
